description: Say how one term of a project stands to another (PM-1053): 'from' rests on 'to' ('dependsOn', the default), is a special case of it ('specialCaseOf'), or is its opposite ('oppositeOf'). 'state' 'confirmed' (the default) keeps the link — shown to readers beside the term and used for the order of reading; 'rejected' turns down a link term_graph proposed, so the definition does not offer it again; 'none' takes a link away. Terms are named by id or spelling, as term_graph returns them; 'to' must be of the project or one above it. Members of the project who may write only.

from.description: The term that rests on the other: id or spelling.

to.description: The term rested on: id or spelling.

name: link_terms
